$comment: The parts of the workbench the guided tour points at (src/tour.ts; app.ts adds each step's action by id), in the tour's order. The same list is the legend of the labelled screenshot in the docs (docs/tools/workbench/, tool-docs.mjs): tools/screenshots.cjs --only map marks each part's first shown target (or `mark`, where the tour's cut-out is a whole pane) and writes the positions to docs/images/guide/workbench-map.json. text: plain words, keys in backticks, {key:<action id>} for a shortcut from keyactions.ts. page: the page of the workbench reference (src/guide.json) that describes the part.

parts.title: Your handlers
parts.text: Each open handler has its own tab. Use the + to start a new one, or to open a file, an example or a Hub handler.

parts.title: The code
parts.text: Write the handler here. Squiggles mark problems, and hovering a name shows its docs. {key:suggest} suggests names and {key:quickFix} fixes things.

parts.title: Check
parts.text: Check lists what Nucleus would reject or get wrong, with the reason and a fix for each. It runs while you type. {key:nextProblem} jumps to the next problem.

parts.title: Try it
parts.text: Runs the handler once per player, like Nucleus would, and shows what each one gets.

parts.title: Docs
parts.text: Every option and function a handler can use, with search. Insert into handler puts an example into your code.

parts.title: Lines
parts.text: A list of every name a handler can use, beside the code. Click one to insert it. {key:lines} opens and closes the list.

parts.title: Files
parts.text: The files of the handler you're working on: handler.js and what goes with it. Click a file to open it in a tab. Link the game's folder at the end, and Check compares the handler's paths with the real files.

parts.title: Save
parts.text: Saves the handler for Nucleus as a .zip, .js or .nc file, or straight into Nucleus Co-op's handlers folder. {key:save} saves.

parts.title: Settings and help
parts.text: Settings, Advanced mode, keyboard shortcuts and What's new are in this menu. So is Take the tour, if you want to see this again.
